main_idea: AfterQuery warmup raised Nemotron 3 Ultra’s GDPval score from 35.3 to 46.7.
ideas: AfterQuery warmup raised GDPval from 35.3 to 46.7.
Warmup left the model 2.8 points behind the teacher.
Comparable open models have about 6× lower throughput.
summary: The chart is clear, but two cards repeat its results and a throughput card adds a separate claim.
